title: Trump open to pardoning Jensen Huang if needed: ‘It’s always an option’
summary_full: The president’s comments came after pressuring Nvidia’s board to reinstall Huang as CEO despite lawmakers’ concerns over national securityDonald Trump said on Tuesday he would be open to pardoning Jensen Huang, the recently reinstalled Nvidia CEO, for potential crimes but didn’t think it would be necessary.“It’s always an option, I guess,” the US president told the New York Post in an interview. “But I don’t think it’ll be necessary.” Continue reading...
